gates.title: UPSC CSE 2025 CSAT Set-B production path
gates.summary: The 2026-07-14 production run was a partial pass. PR #1008 code-fixed all five findings; live migration 264 and browser revalidation remain.
gates.next_action: Apply migration 264, deploy PR #1008, and revalidate Set-B identity, UPSC search, large-paper palette discovery, clear-response persistence, and provenance cleanup.

defects_found.summary: Exact Set-B identity was absent from the learner paper card.
Searching UPSC did not discover the exam.
The 80-question palette did not make lower questions sufficiently discoverable.
The learner could not clear an MCQ response back to unattempted.
Verified paper/source metadata retained stale provenance_pending=true.

defects_fixed.summary: PR #1008 added reviewed paper/set identity to the API and paper card.
PR #1008 expanded catalogue search to normalized name, slug, and exam type.
PR #1008 added a bounded palette scroll area and active-item scrollIntoView.
PR #1008 added Clear response through the existing null-answer sync path.
PR #1008 migration 264 reconciles and prevents stale provenance_pending on verified rows.

blockers: The five code fixes have not yet been revalidated in the deployed learner flow.

gates.title: Migrations 183-190 document/provenance staging validation
gates.summary: The June 24 staging validation covered migration sync, service-role grants, document upload/linking, atomic review/provenance transitions, signed-PDF denial, frontend Replace Doc, cleanup, and Graphify refresh.
gates.next_action: No further action for this historical gate; create a new gate only if the acceptance contract changes.

defects_found.summary: Provenance RPC execute grants were exposed beyond service_role.
Document validation had a precheck-to-mutation race window.
Provenance/link updates and audit writes were not atomic.

defects_fixed.summary: Migration 190 revoked anon/authenticated execution and retained service_role.
Migration 189 locked and revalidated document rows inside the transaction.
Migration 188 made provenance/link mutations and audit insertion atomic.

defects_found.summary: Visibility/unmount event batches could be dropped because sendBeacon could not carry authentication and failed batches were removed before acknowledgement.
Partial event coverage fallback could occur without a persisted warning or fallback count.

PR #800 records event coverage, fallback count, and the partial-coverage warning.

gates.title: P6 scheduler drain validation
gates.summary: The final watcher-based capture proved automatic provenance and a controlled analytics_retry job draining in 19.67 seconds.

defects_found.summary: The earlier capture did not prove automatic scheduler provenance.
The earlier 65-minute observation did not prove the required <=30-second drain cycle.

defects_fixed.summary: The watcher capture recorded manual absent, derivations 1, and errors 0.
The controlled job completed in 19.67 seconds.
